rag.text:
Test: TC-6029 — BP/BG- Verification of functionality on an instance without BPE license
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /
Labels: teamextplatform

Steps:
1. Launch the BP/BG application on an instance without BPE installed
   Expected: App launches correctly
The onboarding screen is displayed
2. Complete the onboarding process
   Expected: App correctly displays the Overview module
3. Navigate to *App configuration > General*
   Expected: Blue icon for BP or green icon for BG are visible
4. Navigate to *App configuration > License*
   Expected: Standard license is displayed
5. Go to Overview and add a new Program Box
   Data: boxName: TC-6029 Box
   Expected: The newly created Box is visible in Overview module
6. Go to the Box configuration of boxName, add any space with projects, and navigate to the Gantt module
   Data: boxName: TC-6029 Box
   Expected: Tasks from the selected space are correctly displayed on the Gantt chart
7. Add a new item
   Data: itemName: TC-6029 Item
   Expected: item is created and displayed properly
8. Rename itemName
   Data: itemName: TC-6029 Item *->* TC-6029 Item_edited
   Expected: The itemNameNew is updated successfully in the BP/BG interface
9. Verify the issue name in Jira
   Data: itemName: TC-6029 Item_edited
   Expected: The name change is correctly reflected in Jira, item looks properly
